exposure: Time since cesarean section (24 hours, 48 hours, 72 hours)
cohort: 385 parturients aged 18-45 years with ASA Physical Status II/IIE who underwent elective or emergency cesarean section under spinal anaesthesia between June 27, 2022 and January 19, 2023
finding: The prevalence of PDPH after spinal anaesthesia in parturients undergoing cesarean section was 7.01% (95% CI 4.53-9.67), with most cases experiencing headache within the first 24 hours.
